title: Perp Liquidation Calculator
description: Computes liquidation price and margin health for perpetual futures positions. Supports isolated and cross-margin modes across Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, Binance, GMX v2, and Aster. Venue-specific MMR tiers, portfolio margin with spot-hedge offset, and GREEN/AMBER/RED health indicator. Zero PII. Client-side.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_perp_margin
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes liquidation price and margin health for perpetual futures positions. Supports isolated and cross-margin across Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, Binance, GMX v2, and Aster. Returns liq price, unrealized PnL, buffer, health status (GREEN/AMBER/RED), and optional portfolio margin efficiency with spot-hedge offset. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/art-213-perp-liquidation-calculator.html for interactive use.

position_size.description: Position size in base asset units

mmr_pct.description: MMR override in % (optional, uses venue default if omitted)

spot_offset_usd.description: USD value of hedging spot position (cross mode only)

correlation.description: Correlation coefficient between perp and spot hedge (0-1, cross mode only)
